author: Tazz
body:
Hello

I am appealing my ban because I do not think it is fair. This mod is allowed on pot pvp servers so I assumed it would be allowed on here. It gives no advantage at all. I assumed it would be allowed on here and did not check the rules because it's a struggle for me to get on the forums. It's the same for other Sky Broadband users such as ImRaging and kiwi123456. I can only get on the forums if I am at someone's house, on a VPN or on 3G. Do you really think I'd go through this to check such a stupid rule that shouldn't be there in the first place?

Recently, there has been a large discussion about BSM, and I was told by a moderator that I was able to use it. However, 4 days ago it was made illegal and not being able to go on the forums, I had no idea and still believed it was legal. Furthermore, if I knew it was illegal, do you think I would upload a video of me using it? I'm not stupid!

Also, I am very sorry for the drama I caused earlier. It was unnecessary and I/we should have dealt with it differently and more appropriately.

Thank you 

-Tazz

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello, 

You have given us a number of arguments to expire your temp-ban we have looked at all the arguments and decided not to unban you.

You claim that the mod is allowed on other servers, thus you thought it would be allowed on Avicus because “it gives no advantage at all”. First, if it doesn’t give you an advantage, why install it? Secondly, why did you not ask anyone? It is just dumb and your own fault for not knowing. 
For not knowing this you say that you have trouble connecting to the forums, but your activity has determined this is a lie. You carry the responsibility to be up to date with the rules, and you clearly stating that you where up to date and I quote “What are you trying to say? I'm fully aware of the rules lmfao.” 
You clearly state in your appeal that you didn’t know BSM wasn’t allowed, this led us to wonder why you bring BSM into this. You told Stormer_, Mango and Zeusy that you weren’t using BSM but another mod that you neither checked with a Moderator or a Tournament staff member if it was allowed. 

You say that you wouldn’t have uploaded the video if you knew it was illegal. So, if you knew you would not have uploaded the video and just lived with it? This is very inappropriate behaviour. Considering the fact that you are not sorry for breaking the rules, taking no responsibility for your actions and knowingly lying in an appeal. In addition the way that you responded to your ban was very immature, and it didn't help the situation.

Regards,
Avicus Network Officials.
